SQLQueries.MobileDashboard_GetBirthdays: SELECT e.Id AS EmployeeId, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.Name)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.FirstName)), ''), CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.MiddleName)), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(e.MiddleName)) END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.LastName)), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(e.LastName)) END))), ''), '') AS EmployeeName, e.DateOfBirth, occ.EventDate AS BirthdayDate, e.Picture, e.DesignationId, e.DepartmentId FROM Employee e CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN MONTH(e.DateOfBirth) = 2 AND DAY(e.DateOfBirth) = 29 AND NOT ((y.Yr % 4 = 0 AND y.Yr % 100 <> 0) OR (y.Yr % 400 = 0)) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(y.Yr, 2, 28) ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(y.Yr, MONTH(e.DateOfBirth), DAY(e.DateOfBirth)) END AS EventDate FROM (VALUES (YEAR(@Today)), (YEAR(@Today) + 1)) y(Yr)) occ WHERE e.TenantId = @TenantId AND e.IsEmployeeActive = 1 AND e.DateOfBirth IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(DAY, -4, occ.EventDate) <= CAST(@Today AS DATE) AND CAST(@Today AS DATE) <= occ.EventDate ORDER BY occ.EventDate DESC, e.Id DESC
SQLQueries.MobileDashboard_GetWorkAnniversaries: SELECT e.Id AS EmployeeId, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.Name)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.FirstName)), ''), CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.MiddleName)), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(e.MiddleName)) END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.LastName)), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(e.LastName)) END))), ''), '') AS EmployeeName, e.DateOfJoining, occ.EventDate AS AnniversaryDate, DATEDIFF(YEAR, e.DateOfJoining, occ.EventDate) AS YearsCompleted, e.Picture, e.DesignationId, e.DepartmentId FROM Employee e CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN MONTH(e.DateOfJoining) = 2 AND DAY(e.DateOfJoining) = 29 AND NOT ((y.Yr % 4 = 0 AND y.Yr % 100 <> 0) OR (y.Yr % 400 = 0)) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(y.Yr, 2, 28) ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(y.Yr, MONTH(e.DateOfJoining), DAY(e.DateOfJoining)) END AS EventDate FROM (VALUES (YEAR(@Today)), (YEAR(@Today) + 1)) y(Yr)) occ WHERE e.TenantId = @TenantId AND e.IsEmployeeActive = 1 AND e.DateOfJoining IS NOT NULL AND occ.EventDate >= CAST(e.DateOfJoining AS DATE) AND DATEADD(DAY, -4, occ.EventDate) <= CAST(@Today AS DATE) AND CAST(@Today AS DATE) <= occ.EventDate ORDER BY occ.EventDate DESC, e.Id DESC
SQLQueries.MobileDashboard_GetAwards: SELECT a.Id AS AwardId, a.Name AS AwardName, a.Date, a.Description, a.Reward, a.Achievement, a.AwardeeId, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.Name)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.FirstName)), ''), CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.MiddleName)), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(e.MiddleName)) END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.LastName)), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(e.LastName)) END))), ''), '') AS AwardeeName, e.Picture, a.BranchId, a.DepartmentId FROM Award a LEFT JOIN Employee e ON e.Id = a.AwardeeId AND e.TenantId = a.TenantId WHERE a.TenantId = @TenantId AND a.Date IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(DAY, -4, CAST(a.Date AS DATE)) <= CAST(@Today AS DATE) AND CAST(@Today AS DATE) <= CAST(a.Date AS DATE) ORDER BY a.Date DESC, a.Id DESC

SQLQueries.GetLocationTrackingConfigurationById: SELECT Id, TenantId, GPSPollingInterval, MinimumDisplacement, GPSAccuracyThreshold, DuplicateLocationRadius, AutoPunchOutTimeout, OfflineStorageLimit, AutoDataCleanupDays, RetryInterval, ServerSyncBatchSize, GeofenceRadius, EnableFromAnywhere, BlockPunchOnHoliday, EnableLocationGapValidation, EnableBatteryOptimizationCheck, BatteryOptimizationMode, AutoPunchOutOnGPSTurnOff, AutoPunchOutOnLocationServicesOff, AutoPunchOutOnAppKilled, AutoPunchOutOnPowerSavingMode, AutoPunchOutOnAirplaneMode, LocationTimeoutDuration FROM LocationTrackingConfiguration WHERE Id = @Id

SQLQueries.GetTodayPunch: SELECT TOP 1 Id, EmployeeId, PunchDate, PunchIn, PunchOut, Duration, PunchInImage, PunchOutImage, PunchOutReason, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId, TenantId AS OrganisationId, InSource, OutSource, CoordinateIn, CoordinateOut, LinkIn, LinkOut FROM Punch WHERE EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND TenantId = @TenantId AND PunchDate = @PunchDate
SQLQueries.InsertPunchTracking: INSERT INTO PunchTracking (TenantId, EmployeeId, PunchId, PunchDate, Direction, PunchIn, PunchOut, Duration, InsertDate, InsertUserId, InSource, OutSource, CoordinateIn, CoordinateOut, LinkIn, LinkOut, PunchInImage,PunchOutImage, Manual, PunchOutReason) VALUES (@TenantId, @EmployeeId, @PunchId, @PunchDate, @Direction, @PunchIn, @PunchOut, @Duration, GETDATE(), @InsertUserId, @InSource, @OutSource, @CoordinateIn, @CoordinateOut, @LinkIn, @LinkOut, @PunchInImage,@PunchOutImage, @Manual, @PunchOutReason); SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS INT);
SQLQueries.GetLastPunchTracking: SELECT TOP 1 Id, TenantId, EmployeeId, PunchId, PunchDate, Direction, CASE WHEN PunchIn IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(PunchIn) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(PunchIn AS TIME)), CAST(PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE PunchIn END AS PunchIn, CASE WHEN PunchOut IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(PunchOut) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(PunchOut AS TIME)), CAST(PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE PunchOut END AS PunchOut, CASE WHEN Duration IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), Duration) AS FLOAT) / 60.0 END AS Duration, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId, InSource, OutSource, CoordinateIn, CoordinateOut, LinkIn, LinkOut, PunchInImage,PunchOutImage, Manual, PunchOutReason FROM PunchTracking WHERE EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND TenantId = @TenantId AND PunchDate = @PunchDate ORDER BY Id DESC
SQLQueries.GetCompletedPunchTrackingDurationSum: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), Duration) AS FLOAT) / 60.0), 0) FROM PunchTracking WHERE PunchId = @PunchId AND Direction = 'OUT' AND Duration IS NOT NULL
SQLQueries.GetLastUnmatchedPunchIn: SELECT TOP 1 Id, TenantId, EmployeeId, PunchId, PunchDate, Direction, CASE WHEN PunchIn IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(PunchIn) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(PunchIn AS TIME)), CAST(PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE PunchIn END AS PunchIn, CASE WHEN PunchOut IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(PunchOut) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(PunchOut AS TIME)), CAST(PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE PunchOut END AS PunchOut, CASE WHEN Duration IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), Duration) AS FLOAT) / 60.0 END AS Duration, InsertDate, InsertUserId, UpdateDate, UpdateUserId, InSource, OutSource, CoordinateIn, CoordinateOut, LinkIn, LinkOut, PunchInImage,PunchOutImage, Manual, PunchOutReason FROM PunchTracking WHERE PunchId = @PunchId AND Direction = 'IN' AND Id > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(Id) FROM PunchTracking WHERE PunchId = @PunchId AND Direction = 'OUT'), 0) ORDER BY Id DESC
SQLQueries.GetPunchTrackingTimeline: SELECT pt.Id, pt.PunchId, pt.EmployeeId, e.Name AS EmployeeName, pt.PunchDate, pt.Direction, CASE WHEN pt.PunchIn IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(pt.PunchIn) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(pt.PunchIn AS TIME)), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE pt.PunchIn END AS PunchIn, CASE WHEN pt.PunchOut IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(pt.PunchOut) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(pt.PunchOut AS TIME)), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE pt.PunchOut END AS PunchOut, CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN CASE WHEN pt.PunchIn IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(pt.PunchIn) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(pt.PunchIn AS TIME)), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE pt.PunchIn END ELSE CASE WHEN pt.PunchOut IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(pt.PunchOut) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(pt.PunchOut AS TIME)), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE pt.PunchOut END END AS PunchTime, CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN pt.InSource ELSE pt.OutSource END AS Source, CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN pt.CoordinateIn ELSE pt.CoordinateOut END AS Coordinate, CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN pt.LinkIn ELSE pt.LinkOut END AS Address, pt.PunchOutImage, pt.Manual, pt.PunchOutReason AS Remarks FROM PunchTracking pt INNER JOIN Employee e ON e.Id = pt.EmployeeId WHERE pt.PunchId = @PunchId AND pt.EmployeeId = @EmployeeId AND pt.TenantId = @TenantId ORDER BY CASE WHEN pt.Direction = 'IN' THEN CASE WHEN YEAR(pt.PunchIn) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(pt.PunchIn AS TIME)), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE pt.PunchIn END ELSE CASE WHEN YEAR(pt.PunchOut) <= 1900 THEN DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME), CAST(pt.PunchOut AS TIME)), CAST(pt.PunchDate AS DATETIME)) ELSE pt.PunchOut END END ASC
SQLQueries.Asset_GetList: SELECT a.Id, a.Number, a.AssetCode, a.QRCodePath, a.QRCodeText, a.QRCodeGeneratedDate, a.AssetName, a.Description, a.AssetStatusId, s.[Name] AS AssetStatus, a.AssetCategoryId, c.[Name] AS AssetCategory, a.AssetTypeId, at.TypeName AS AssetType, a.DepartmentId, d.[Name] AS Department, a.BranchId, b.[Name] AS Branch, a.BusinessUnitId, bu.[Name] AS BusinessUnit, a.Owner, a.Location, a.PurchaseDate, a.PurchasePrice, a.ActualValue, a.PurchaseOrderNumber, a.PurchaseOrderBill, a.Manufacturer, a.Model, a.SerialNumber, a.ProductionYear, a.SupportCenter, a.AssetTagNumber, a.WarrantyExpiryDate, a.MaintenanceDueDate, a.DepreciationPercentage, a.Images, a.InsertDate, a.InsertUserId, a.UpdateDate, a.UpdateUserId FROM [dbo].[Asset] a LEFT JOIN [dbo].[AssetStatus] s ON s.Id = a.AssetStatusId LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Asset Category] c ON c.Id = a.AssetCategoryId LEFT JOIN [dbo].[AssetType] at ON at.Id = a.AssetTypeId LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Department] d ON d.Id = a.DepartmentId LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Branch] b ON b.Id = a.BranchId LEFT JOIN [dbo].[BusinessUnit] bu ON bu.Id = a.BusinessUnitId WHERE a.TenantId = @TenantId ORDER BY a.Number DESC

SQLQueries.AssetDashboard_GetKpiMetrics: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.InsertDate < @StartOfMonth THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TotalPrevCount, SUM(CASE WHEN {IN_USE} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InUseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN {IN_USE} AND a.InsertDate < @StartOfMonth THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InUsePrevCount, SUM(CASE WHEN {MAINTENANCE} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MaintenanceCount, SUM(CASE WHEN {MAINTENANCE} AND a.InsertDate < @StartOfMonth THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MaintenancePrevCount, SUM(CASE WHEN {OUT_OF_SERVICE} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OutOfServiceCount, SUM(CASE WHEN {OUT_OF_SERVICE} AND a.InsertDate < @StartOfMonth THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OutOfServicePrevCount FROM [dbo].[Asset] a LEFT JOIN [dbo].[AssetStatus] s ON s.Id = a.AssetStatusId WHERE a.TenantId = @TenantId
